node-1.label: Decreased vision in the right eye, symptom onset 4 days prior to presentation

node-2.label: A white woman in her 20s with unremarkable medical and ocular history was struck by lightning directly to the right forehead while hiking 4 days before presentation

node-3.label: Initial examination showed uncorrected visual acuity of 20/50 OD and 20/20 OS, symmetric pupils with no relative afferent pupillary defect, normal anterior segment with no cataract, and no apparent abnormalities on dilated fundus examination in either eye

node-4.label: Follow-up at 2 weeks revealed central macular thickening on fundus examination; at 7 weeks, a mild posterior subcapsular cataract was visible in the right eye

why.why: Radiologist analysis confirms OCT shows delayed right macular thickening and outer retinal disruption at two weeks with partial restoration at four months, a pattern fitting lightning injury. Combined with the direct forehead strike and delayed cataract, this strongly supports lightning-induced eye injury. Confidence is tempered slightly because slit-lamp and ERG were not performed and the cataract was not independently verified, but the objective findings rule out functional and pre-existing causes.

The objective OCT findings of delayed outer retinal disruption and partial restoration, appearing after direct lightning trauma, provide structural evidence that cannot be explained by functional vision loss. The normal initial exam is outweighed by these delayed objective findings.

The patient had an unremarkable ocular history and normal baseline examination, and the new OCT findings are temporally linked to the direct forehead lightning strike. There is no evidence of pre-existing ocular disease, and the delayed structural changes are characteristic of lightning injury.

node-8.label: OCT at two weeks shows right macular thickening and outer retinal disruption; at four months shows partial restoration

node-9.label: Slit-lamp examination and ERG were not performed; posterior subcapsular cataract not independently verified
